title: KALAVE Premium Stainless Steel Funnel, 5 Inch Food Grade Kitchen Funnels with 200 Mesh Food Filter Strainer for Filling Bottles, Oils, Juice, Wine, Coffee, Milk
description:
About this item
Food-Grade Funnel Set: Kalave metal funnel crafted from 100% food grade high-quality stainless steel, The detachable 200 mesh funnel strainer made of PP frame and 200 fine mesh nylon filters. Funnel set is safe, non-toxic, sturdy and durable. compatible for most bottles, jars and other containers. The premium food-grade stainless steel funnel set resist bending, breaking, corrosion and rusting, and stay safe and beautifully with you for life.
A funnel with two removable strainers: The 200 mesh funnel strainer helps you to filter the fine grains. It is perfect for filling bottles or transferring liquid ingredients such as oils, fry oil, sloe gin, wine, juice, milk, goat milk, soy milk, beer. The stainless steel strainer helps you filter hot cooking oil, grease, soup or seeds from homemade juice. You can also separate the strainer and use it as a standard funnel to fill a pepper、spice、salt, jam, particulates, powder.
Protecting hands: The kitchen funnel handle is designed for protecting hands while transferring hot things, and it can be used to hang the Food funnel on a hook when not in use, saving storage space and maintaining hygiene.
Super Easy to Clean: The funnel and the stainless steel strainer and 200 mesh food filter strainer is completely dishwasher safe.
What You Get: The 8-In-1 food grade funnel set contains 1 x stainless steel funnel, 1 x stainless steel stainer, 1 x 200 Mesh oil strainer, 1 x Cleaning Brush, and 4 x Sticky Hooks. our worry-free 2-years warranty, and great customer service. Great for value and practical, this funnel with strainer set can meet all your food-transferring needs while solving the storage and cleaning problem.

Quick Shipping!amazing little milk filter and funnel. i was actually going to give it a bad review after using it a few weeks and realizing how much gunk was not getting cleaned when i was washing it. but i figured out how to take it apart. if you flip it over on the under side, you'll see at the four points where there's a little square in the ring. on the top side at those points is a tiny little slit where you can stick a screwdriver to pop it out. it doesn't show in the photographs, but it's there. once you get it opened up, you can clean it up (last pic) and then put it back in. it does get MUCH cleaner in the dishwasher than it does handwashing and even soaking it all day in vinegar or hydrogen peroxide. we started using the dishwasher again and every time i washed it, a little more gunk would come out, but it still wasn't getting completely clean (middle pic where i first took it apart). now that it's clean, the dishwasher seems to be doing a good enough job, but at least i know i can take it apart and get it ALL clean again if i need to.
